description: BENCHMARK: fresh L1 character with no gear / no imbues / no companions drives AutoProgressionService until it reliably clears dangerLevel 10 at >=50%. Measures time-to-target in simulated hours. Post task #134, a legendary (min 7 / max 10) recipe path exists: Mithril Blade, Ardweld Cuirass, Starforged Crown/Greaves/Treads, Wyrdbound Buckler/Gauntlets, Wyrdforged Sigil. These gate on new top-tier materials (Wyrdforged Core, Starforged Ingot) that only drop from Ashen Reach / Maw Borderlands / Caervorn bosses and their biome pools at scarce weight. Expected baseline: a fresh L1 pursuing the endgame loop should reach reliable d10 clears within ~60h of simulated play (was 'never' before gear-ceiling lifted to baseWorkmanshipMax=10 across all slots). Sub-modes auto-craft and auto-imbue still stubbed as of 2026-04-13; cell-grid win-rate expectation remains in 'hard' band until sub-modes ship and the full loop runs end-to-end. Engine-compatibility: reuses the standard (playerLevel, dangerLevel) cell grid so PlaybookEngine runs it without changes; 'benchmark' semantics (time-to-target, grace-window) are driven server-side by AutoProgressionService in live play.

timeToTarget.preTaskStatus: unreachable: no recipe existed with baseWorkmanshipMax=10 for chest/head/legs/hands/feet — progression capped around workmanship 8-9.
timeToTarget.postTaskExpectation: reachable within ~60h: legendary tier-5 recipes covering all major slots are now data-authored and gated on scarce boss-drop materials. Exact hour figure pending an AutoProgressionService sub-mode implementation pass.
